subject: Vendor portal onboarding: PO acceptance fields, remittance mapping & test invoice
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@acme-retail.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-07-25T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: AP onboarding: vendor record + PO acceptance fields

Hi Jonas,

We're starting the vendor enrollment for Redwood Inference in Acme's supplier portal and I wanted to collect a couple of specific items so our AP team can route POs and pay on-time. Attached is our current AP onboarding template (Acme_AP_Onboarding_Fields_v2.xlsx). Can you confirm the following?

- Legal entity name to appear on invoices (company name + any DBA)
- Tax/VAT registration number(s) for US/EU entities (we have EU business units that will require EORI or VAT ID on invoices)
- Remittance instructions (bank name, ACH routing, SWIFT/BIC if applicable) and preferred remit account name
- Which invoice header field you expect to contain our customer PO number (some portals look for 'PO', others for 'Related Order')
- Any supplier ID that we should map to our portal to auto-attach POs to invoices

A few asks from AP: they prefer a test (zero-dollar) invoice to validate mapping before sending production invoices, and they require the first invoice to reference the DocuSign vendor registration ID in the invoice notes.

Can you also confirm whether you can provide a sample invoice PDF that matches your live header so we can map the OCR rules? If so, please attach.

Thanks — if easier we can schedule a short call with our portal team tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Elena Martinez
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Retail
Attachments: Acme_AP_Onboarding_Fields_v2.xlsx
From: jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@acme-retail.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com, rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-07-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AP onboarding: vendor record + PO acceptance fields

Elena — thanks for the clear template. Quick answers and proposed plan below.

- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (please map "Redwood Inference" and "Redwood Inference, Inc." as aliases). We do not operate under a DBA.
- Tax/VAT: US EIN: 84-1234567. EU VAT (Redwood EU Services Ltd): GB123456789 (we can supply a scanned VAT cert if needed).
- Remit: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  Bank: First Valley Bank
  ACH (USD): 021000021 / Account 123456789
  SWIFT: FVBBUS33XXX
  Please flag payments to remit@redwood-inference.com for reconciliation.
- PO field: we recommend mapping to the portal field labeled 'PO#' (if you must pick one). We also place the PO in a single-line header as 'PO: XXXX' for OCR robustness.
- Supplier ID: We don't have an existing Acme supplier ID. If you can create one, please share it and we'll include it as 'Acme Supplier ID' on invoices.

Attachments: I'm attaching a production-like sample invoice (redwood_sample_invoice.pdf) and our internal vendor enroll playbook (vendor-enroll-playbook.docx) with recommended field names for OCR and common fallbacks.

Proposed next steps:
1) You provision a sandbox supplier record for "Redwood Inference" so we can test the PO-to-invoice mapping.
2) We upload a 0.00 test invoice referencing the DocuSign vendor registration ID and your newly-created Supplier ID.
3) Once mapping is green, we will send the first production invoice with the agreed header.

Happy to jump on the call — Laura and Rachel are copied to coordinate finance and legal items. Are you available 7/26 10:00–11:00 PT?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_sample_invoice.pdf; vendor-enroll-playbook.docx
From: Elena Martinez <elena@acme-retail.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-07-26T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AP onboarding: vendor record + PO acceptance fields

Thanks Jonas — that helps a lot. Portal notes: our AP system requires either 'PO#' in the top-right or a line item called 'Related Order' to auto-link. We'll create both rules to be safe.

I sent a DocuSign vendor registration link to the legal team (they completed it this morning). Portal sent the confirmation and a temporary supplier ID: ACME-71234. I've attached a screenshot of the portal panel showing where to upload the sample invoice and where the supplier ID lives.

We set up a sandbox record here: https://acme-retail.ap-portal.example/sandbox/organizations/redwood-inference (credentials were shared separately to your security@redwood-inference.com address). Please upload the sample invoice to the sandbox and then submit a 0.00 test invoice referencing DocuSign ID DS-2026-07-25-ELM and Supplier ID ACME-71234.

One note on VAT: for EU shipments, the portal also expects the VAT ID in a field labeled 'Tax ID / VAT'. When the VAT field is present, it will be included on the invoice header in OCR results.

Attachments: acme_portal_screenshot.png

Elena
From: jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@acme-retail.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com, rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-07-28T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: RE: AP onboarding: vendor record + PO acceptance fields — next steps and mutual action plan

Elena — pulling together a short checklist and confirmed next steps so your team has a single reference.

Vendor onboarding checklist (what Redwood will do):
- Upload redwood_sample_invoice.pdf to sandbox and create a 0.00 test invoice with PO field populated as 'PO: TEST-0001'.
- Confirm invoice OCR mapping (we will take screenshots and share any field mismatches).
- Provide scanned VAT cert for Redwood EU Services Ltd to procurement@acme-retail.com if you need the physical cert.
- Add 'Acme Supplier ID: ACME-71234' in the invoice footer for reconciliation.

What we need from Acme before production invoices:
- Confirm Supplier ID is persisted on the live portal and provide the canonical field name for 'PO#' (is it 'PO', 'PO#', or 'Related Order'?)
- Confirm that remit-to bank details are accepted for automated ACH; notify if any intermediary or payment routing needs to be added to the vendor record.
- Confirm whether your system strips leading zeros on PO numbers (we have a few accounting systems that do).

Proposed schedule:
- 7/28: Redwood uploads test invoice to sandbox and notifies AP.
- 7/29: Acme verifies mapping and confirms acceptance OR provides mappings to adjust.
- 8/02: First production invoice (if sandbox validated).

If that works, can we lock in a 30-minute call on 7/29 09:00 PT to review the live sandbox mapping? Laura and Rachel will be on the call for reconciliation and legal items. I've also attached a short vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf to drop into your portal.

Thanks again — we'll start the sandbox upload now and send a confirmation when the 0.00 invoice is live.

—Jonas
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf
